programmes.d: Jonathan reveals his angelic origins, then must save the senior-citizens home from developers.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Hello and Farewell - Part 1
programmes.d: Jonathan helps Commander Michaels to deal with flashbacks of Vietnam; he also tries to convince her to go to therapy. Mark deals with his fear of flying.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Silent Bell
programmes.d: A pastor must follow a church council's decision to fire most of the staff at the school because they're not Christian.
A terminally ill boy takes in another boy who's continually in trouble with the law.
Mark attends his high school class reunion and learns that some memories are bittersweet for his old friends.
Jonathan and Mark help aging movie heroes to stand up to a street gang known as Satan's Helpers.

A teenage girl tells school reporters that a driver came on to her right before the bus got into an accident. She may not be telling the truth. Jonathan tries to teach the news writers the correct way to report a story.
Jonathan and Mark assist a young country singer who is hoping to follow in her mother's footsteps.
The problems of the handicapped are addressed when an amputee joins a crusade after a false fire alarm.
Jonathan must find a way to help a college football star whose dreams are shattered by an accident.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Goodbye, Mr. Zelinka
programmes.d: Mr. Zelinka is a beloved teacher who is being forced to retire because he's old. Jonathan and Mark know that he would prefer to continue teaching.
Gymnastics rehabilitate a man's (Jim Haynie) paralyzed son (Ken Olandt); guest Bart Conner.
The parents of two Vietnamese children come to America to look for them after a ten-year separation.
Jonathan (Michael Landon) helps a tycoon who is living in a fantasy. With Victor French.
After having been scarred in a fire, an actress becomes a counselor at a summer camp for blind children. The camp is run by Jonathan and Mark's blind friend Frank.
Mark and Jonathan try to reach a movie star who is a stranger to his own children.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Inner Limits
programmes.d: A young man decides to institutionalize his brother who has been completely paralyzed and speechless for many years, against the wishes of their mother.
Mark falls for an actress.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: It's a Dog's Life
programmes.d: Mark believes that God has turned Jonathan into a dog. Meanwhile, he must contend with a runaway kid and the kid's scatterbrained mother.
Family and friends of a Vietnam veteran won't accept his Amerasian daughter.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Merry Christmas from Grandpa
programmes.d: On Christmas Eve, Jonathan shows three men what will happen in the future if the Earth continues to be ravaged by pollution. One of the men is an energy official another is a farmer and the third one is the President.
Jonathan and Mark are bellhops at a hotel that has been given to an aimless young man by his father.

In the series opener, we meet Jonathan Smith, a probationary angel who has been sent to help people on Earth. He befriends residents at a retirement home. The administrator at the home has a brother named Mark who is suspicious of Jonathan.
Jonathan and Mark try to help a heartless used car salesman reconsider his actions on Christmas Eve.
Jonathan helps the residents of Havencrest, when they learn that the retirement home is going to be sold. Jonathan must reveal his real identity to Mark in order to complete the assignment.
Investigating a friend's death, Mark encounters drug smugglers; guests Michael Bowen, Lee Bryant.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: To Touch The Moon
programmes.d: Jonathan helps a terminally ill boy and his mother. Meanwhile, Mark deals with a thief abandoned by his folks.
Jonathan attempts to fan the flames of love between a woman and her ex-husband's best friend.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Return of the Masked Rider
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark help aging movie heroes to stand up to a street gang known as Satan's Helpers. They persuade a young boxer not to throw a big fight when the gang tries to bully him.
Mark is in a state between life and death when he's critically injured in a car accident.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Song of the Wild West
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark assist a young country singer who is hoping to follow in her mother's footsteps. Next, they help a widow mourning her late husband.
Jonathan steps in when a heart condition sidelines a promising basketball player's dreams.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: One Fresh Batch of Lemonade - Part 1
programmes.d: Jonathan must find a way to help Deke, a college football star whose dreams of reaching the pros are shattered by a tragic motorcycle accident.
A dying woman tries to reconcile with her stern father for the sake of her illegitimate daughter.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: One Fresh Batch of Lemonade - Part 2
programmes.d: Jonathan enlists the aid of a gymnast to rehabilitate Deke. Meanwhile, Deke's parents have been deeply affected by the accident.
Mark and Jonathan's quadriplegic friend falls in love with Mark's cousin.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: A Divine Madness
programmes.d: A construction company tycoon now believes he's King Arthur, and his estranged son determines to have him declared incompetent. Can Jonathan work a reconciliation?
Jonathan arranges an exchange between a pitiless millionaire and a kind vagrant.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Catch A Falling Star
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark have been hired to look after the kids of a movie star who never has time to spend with his family.
Jonathan and Mark meet a child star whose fame is spoiling her rotten and destroying her family.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Help Wanted: Angel
programmes.d: An elderly scriptwriter needs someone to bankroll his movie. Meanwhile, Mark has fallen in love with an attractive woman, but Jonathan receives news about her from higher up.
Jonathan encourages residents in a neighborhood to unite against a cold-hearted developer.
Jonathan and Mark must help an Amerasian girl facing racial prejudice when she goes to live with her father's family in the United States.
Jonathan helps a widowed retirement-home resident realize life is worth living.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Hotel Of Dreams
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark are bellhops at a hotel that has been given to an aimless young man by his father. They must deal with an unkind boss, an obnoxious kid and a difficult guest.
Lizzy MacGill is a horse trainer's young daughter who elopes with Garth Armstrong, a privileged man.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Another Song For Christmas
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark try to help a heartless used car salesman reconsider his actions on Christmas Eve.
Jonathan and Mark try to help Lizzie. The new bride has cancer and she is pregnant.
Jonathan and Mark investigate a gang of drug smugglers after an old friend of Mark's has mysteriously disappeared.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: One Winged Angels
programmes.d: Jonathan attempts to fan the flames of love between a woman and her ex-husband's best friend. But his efforts backfire when he falls for the woman himself.
Mark and Jonathan become counselors at a camp for children with cancer.
